explanation: It began in Paris in 1865 as the International Telegraph Union, to link Europe's telegraph networks. It became a UN agency after the Second World War.

claims.text: The International Telecommunication Union was founded in Paris on 17 May 1865, as the International Telegraph Union.
The United Nations was founded in 1945.
The International Telegraph Union was set up to coordinate the telegraph networks of its member states, mostly European.
The ITU became a specialized agency of the United Nations after the Second World War.
